name: com.kobapps.a2bkit
description: A-to-B reward and feedback effects: coins flying to a wallet HUD, floating score text, XP orbs. One configuration model across 2D, 3D and Canvas space, with zero per-frame allocation, live endpoint tracking, trails and on-hit impacts, UniTask async, and a first-class FirstItemArrived hook so the counter starts when the first coin actually lands.

samples.description: Nine scenes: coin to wallet, coin burst to wallet, floating score text (click a star), XP orbs, 3D mesh collect, particle burst, moving target, cross-space, and multiple effects at once.
